name: knext-vinext-bun-og-fixture
description: Minimal vinext + bun-exec app used ONLY by vinext-compile-og-exec.test.ts (cluster C4 — next/og ImageResponse in the compiled single executable). Pinned to the REPO's current vinext version (packages/kn-next/package.json), same as vinext-node-app, and checked by tests/vinext-pin-lockstep.test.ts. The vite.config.ts plugin shape (inlineDynamicImports) matches the real knext scaffold template and apps/file-manager, NOT a hand-rolled shortcut: a bare `nitro({preset:'bun'})` with code splitting on produces a server bundle that crashes at BOOT on this vinext version (a split-off chunk uses import.meta.filename, which --bytecode cannot carry for a non-entry chunk) — the exact failure class this app's own entry-asset-anchor.mjs fix is a sibling of, but for a DIFFERENT import.meta use this app does not touch. `overrides.@vercel/og` pins a KNOWN-WORKING og release: vinext@1.0.1 itself pins @vercel/og EXACTLY at 1.0.3, and 1.0.0 through 1.0.3 all ship broken standalone (missing dist/hb.wasm, confirmed with a bare `bun add @vercel/og` + ImageResponse call, zero vinext/nitro/Bun-compile involvement) -- filed separately, not this PR's bug, not fixable by this app's asset-anchor mechanism (hb.wasm is read via `__dirname`-based `locateFile()`, not `new URL(lit, import.meta.url)`, and the file does not exist ANYWHERE in the installed tree for this app to embed). Not a symlink or workspace member: its deps are installed into a throwaway build dir by the test, never built in place.
